y-m-12-04.goal: Enzanisa, sehwaro hwekutaura nezve 'zvimiro zvose', data yakawanikwa nekuyera netsananguro yakawanikwa nekuparadzanisa chimiro, sarudza iyo inokodzera zvakanyanya, uye ushandise nzira imwe chete kuchimiro chitsva.
y-m-12-04.material: Sua naJunho vari kutaura nezvekuti 'huwandu hwemakona mana e quadrilateral ndi360°' hwakarurama kuma quadrilateral ose here. Funga ma quadrilateral asina gomba rinoenda mukati chete. Sua: 'Ndakayera ma quadrilateral 5 ne protractor ndikawedzera makona mana, ndikawana 359°, 361°, 360°, 362°, 358°. Saka huwandu hwe quadrilateral imwe neimwe ndi360°.' Junho: 'Kana ukadhirowa diagonal imwe mu quadrilateral, inoparadzana kuita ma triangle maviri. Huwandu hwemakona matatu e triangle imwe ndi180°, saka huwandu hwemakona mana e quadrilateral ndi360°.'
y-m-12-04.thinking.0: Kuenzanisa marudzi ehwaro (data yakayerwa netsananguro ine zvikonzero)
y-m-12-04.prereq.0: Huwandu hwemakona matatu e triangle ndi180°
y-m-12-04.prereq.1: Zvinoreva quadrilateral ne diagonal (chikamu chinobatanidza ma vertex maviri asiri padhuze)
y-m-12-04.prereq.2: Tinobata ma quadrilateral asina gomba rinoenda mukati chete
y-m-12-04.s.s1.prompt: Enzanisa tsananguro dzeshamwari mbiri sehwaro hwekutaura nezve 'ma quadrilateral ose'. Ndeipi inokodzera zvakanyanya?
y-m-12-04.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kuti unogona kuvimbisa here kuti kuyera quadrilateral yechi6 nenzira yaSua kuchapa 360° chaizvo.
y-m-12-04.s.s1.hint.1: Dhirowa imwe quadrilateral uye uedze tsananguro yaJunho pairi kuti uone kuti inogona kushandiswa sezvayakaita kune quadrilateral ipi neipi here.
y-m-12-04.s.s1.o.a: Tsananguro yaSua yakanaka kupfuura. Akayera ma quadrilateral 5 pachake uye mhedzisiro dzose dzaiva padhuze ne360°
y-m-12-04.s.s1.r.a: Kuyera ikuongorora kunokosha, asi zvakaoma kutaura kuti ma quadrilateral ose akafanana nekuti 5 chete akayerwa. Kunosara mukana wekuti quadrilateral inotevera yakasiyana.
y-m-12-04.s.s1.o.b: Tsananguro mbiri idzi dziri hwaro hwenhanho imwe chete. Dzose dzinotaura mhedzisiro imwe chete, kuti huwandu ndi360°
y-m-12-04.s.s1.r.b: Kunyangwe mhedzisiro dzakafanana, kuti dzinoratidza 'nei zvakadaro' kunosiyana. Enzanisa kuti tsananguro ipi inogona kushandiswa sezvayakaita kune quadrilateral itsva.
y-m-12-04.s.s1.o.c: Hapana ari hwaro. Haugoni kuyera ma quadrilateral ose, uye tsananguro inewo mienzaniso mishoma chete
y-m-12-04.s.s1.r.c: Kunyangwe usingagoni kuyera ose, kutsanangura nezvikonzero kunokubvumira kutaura nezvenyaya dzose pakarepo. Tarisa kuti tsananguro yaJunho yakadaro here.
y-m-12-04.s.s1.o.d: Tsananguro yaJunho ihwaro. Quadrilateral ipi neipi inogona kuparadzaniswa ne diagonal, uye kuyera kwaSua ndekwekutarisa
y-m-12-04.s.s1.r.d: Wakacherekedza kuti nei nzira iyi inoshanda kuma quadrilateral ose nenzira imwe chete, uye wakachengeta kuyera sekutarisa.
y-m-12-04.s.s1.explain: Tsananguro yaJunho inovimba nechokwadi chekuti quadrilateral ipi neipi (isina gomba) inogona kuparadzaniswa kuita ma triangle maviri ne diagonal, saka inotsigira 'ose'. Kuyera kwaSua kunogona kushandiswa kutarisa kuti tsananguro yakarurama. Asi cherekedza kuti tsananguro yaJunho inovimbawo kuti 'huwandu hwemakona matatu e triangle ndi180°'.
y-m-12-04.s.s2.prompt: Kana Sua akayera, paivawo nema quadrilateral ane huwandu hwe358° ne362°. Zvakanaka kunzwisisa sei mhedzisiro iyi?
y-m-12-04.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga kuti makosha mashanu mangani ari kudivi diki nekudivi guru re360.
y-m-12-04.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti kuyera quadrilateral imwe chete kaviri kunopa kukosha kwakafanana chaizvo here.
y-m-12-04.s.s2.o.a: Makosha akayerwa ne protractor anogona kusiyana nenge 1~2°, saka mhedzisiro dzakabuda padhuze ne360°
y-m-12-04.s.s2.r.a: Wakazvinzwisisa sekukanganisa kwekuyera kunowanzoitika. Chiratidzo zvakare chekuti hukuru hwekukanganisa hudiki uye hunopararira kumativi ose maviri e360°.
y-m-12-04.s.s2.o.b: Humbowo hwekuti pane ma quadrilateral ane huwandu husiri 360°. Nekuti makosha 358° ne362° akabuda chaizvo
y-m-12-04.s.s2.r.b: 358° ne362° dzinotsauka nehuwandu hwakafanana kumativi ose maviri. Enzanisa kuti dzinoramba dzichitsauka kudivi rimwe chete here.
y-m-12-04.s.s2.o.c: Humbowo hwekuti tsananguro yaJunho haina kururama. Nekuti makosha akayerwa haaenzani chaizvo nekukosha kwakawanikwa netsananguro
y-m-12-04.s.s2.r.c: Tsananguro yaJunho itsananguro ine zvikonzero, saka zvakaoma kutaura pakarepo kuti haina kururama nekuti makosha mashoma akayerwa akasiyana zvishoma.
y-m-12-04.s.s2.o.d: Kuyera ne protractor kunofanira kugara kuchipa 360° chaizvo, saka kukosha kwose kusiri 360° kwakayerwa zvisina kururama
y-m-12-04.s.s2.r.d: Misiyano inobva pakuverenga zviratidzo inowanzoitika. Zvakanyanya kuva kukanganisa kupfuura kuyera kwakashata.
y-m-12-04.s.s2.explain: Makosha akayerwa anowanzo siyana ne1~2° nekuda kwenzira yekuverenga nezviratidzo. 358°, 359°, 361°, 362° dzakapararira kumativi ose maviri e360°, saka zvinonzwisisika kudzitora sekukanganisa. Asi haugoni kuita mhedziso ye '360° chaizvo' kubva pakuyera oga, saka tsananguro ine zvikonzero inodiwawo.
y-m-12-04.s.s3.prompt: Enderera nenzira yaJunho. Huwandu hwemakona mashanu e pentagon isina gomba rinoenda mukati ndehupi? Nyora kuti wakahuwana sei. Hazvina basa kana nzira yako yakasiyana.
y-m-12-04.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza vertex imwe ye pentagon, dhirowa ma diagonal kubva pavertex iyoyo kuenda kuma vertex mamwe, uye uverenge kuti ma triangle mangani anoumbwa.
y-m-12-04.s.s3.hint.1: Mushure mekuverenga huwandu hwema triangle, shandisa huwandu hwemakona matatu e triangle imwe kutsvaga zvose.
y-m-12-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Zviri pachena munzira yako here kuti wakaparadzanisa kuita ma triangle mangani?
y-m-12-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kuenzanisa nenzira yeshamwari yaimwe (mhinduro yemuenzaniso) kunopa mhedzisiro imwe chete here?
y-m-12-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Nzira iyi inogona kushandiswa sezvayakaita kuma pentagon mamwe asina gomba rinoenda mukati here?
y-m-12-04.s.s3.model.0: Kana ukadhirowa ma diagonal maviri kubva pavertex imwe, inoparadzana kuita ma triangle 3. Huwandu hwemakona e triangle imwe ndi180°, saka ndi3 nguva 180°, iyo ndi540°.
y-m-12-04.s.s3.model.1: Kana ukaisa poinzi mukati me pentagon ukaibatanidza kuma vertex 5, ma triangle 5 anoumbwa. 5 nguva 180° ndi900°, asi kutenderera kwakazara kwe360° kutenderedza poinzi yepakati hakusi kona ye pentagon, saka kuibvisa kunopa 540°.
y-m-12-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Iyi imwe nzira inoshandisa poinzi yemukati.
y-m-12-04.s.s3.model.2: Kana ukaparadzanisa pentagon ne diagonal kuita quadrilateral imwe ne triangle imwe, ndi360°+180°=540°.
y-m-12-04.s.s3.modelNote.2: Iyi inzira inoshandisa mhedzisiro yatozivikanwa ye quadrilateral.

y-m-12-06.title: Chimiro chakatsvairwa chakafanana nechimiro chakatenderedzwa here?
y-m-12-06.topic: Kuenzanisa mhedzisiro dzekutsvaira nekutenderedza chimiro che plane
y-m-12-06.goal: Tsvaga, nekuyedza zvimiro zvakawanda, mamiriro apo kutsvaira kumusoro-pasi nekutenderedza 180° zvinopa mhedzisiro imwe chete, uye gadzira chimiro chako uye ufanotaure mhedzisiro.
y-m-12-06.material: Zvimiro zvakagadzirwa nemaceli esquare. Celi rakaitwa ruvara rinonyorwa ■, uye celi risina chinhu rinonyorwa □. Kutendeuka kumusoro-pasi ichimiro chakatarisirwa mugirazi kuti kumusoro nepasi zvichinjane (kuruboshwe nekurudyi zvinoramba zvakadaro). Kutendeuka 180° ichimiro chakatendeudzwa hafu yekutenderera (kumusoro kunoenda pasi, uye kuruboshwe kunoenda kurudyi). Yuna akati, 'Chimiro chakatendeudzwa kumusoro-pasi chinogara chakafanana nechimiro chakatendeudzwa 180°.'
y-m-12-06.thinking.2: Kufungidzira mamiriro uye kufungidzira nyaya itsva
y-m-12-06.prereq.0: Nzira dzekutsvedza, kutendeuka, nekutenderera zvimiro zveplane (kutendeuka kumusoro-pasi, kutenderera clockwise)
y-m-12-06.prereq.1: Kuverenga zvimiro zvakagadzirwa nemaceli esquare nemashoko
y-m-12-06.s.s1.prompt: Ngatiedzei zvimiro rimwe nenguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza zvaunofunga nezvemashoko aYuna.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.hint.0: Tevera kuti celi rimwe rakaitwa ruvara rinoenda kupi mukufamba kwose kuviri.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.hint.1: Fananidza zvimiro zvaiva zvakafanana (A, C) zvichibva kuruboshwe nekurudyi.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.0.info: Chimiro A irectangle yemitsara 2 nemaceli 3 ane maceli ose 6 ■. Chimiro chakatendeudzwa kumusoro-pasi nechimiro chakatendeudzwa 180° zvose marectangle ane maceli ose 6 ■. Zvakafanana.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga chii zvino nezvemashoko aYuna e 'zvinogara zvakafanana'?
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.0.after: Zvaiva zvakafanana kuna A, asi kana maceli ose akaitwa ruvara, rinogona kuita serakafanana kunyange rikafambiswa sei, saka humbowo hwakaneta. Zvakakodzera kuedza nezvimwe zvimiro.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zvakafanana kuchimiro chimwe, saka zvakanaka kutenda kuti zvinogara zvakafanana
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Chimiro chimwe hachikwani. Maceli ose echimiro ichi akaitwa ruvara, saka chingava chimiro chakasarudzika.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvakabuda zvakafanana, asi chimiro chakasarudzika chine maceli ose akaitwa ruvara, saka ndinoda kuedzawo zvimwe zvimiro
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaedza kuongorora kana mhedzisiro imwe yakajairika.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Chirevo che 'zvinogara zvakafanana' hachirurami. Kutendeuka nekutenderera zvine mazita akasiyana, saka mhedzisiro dzakasiyanawo
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Haugoni kutaura kuti mhedzisiro dzakasiyana nokuti mazita akasiyana. Unofanira kuongorora nechimiro chaicho.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hatisati taziva kuti chii chinoitika nezvimwe zvimiro.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.1.info: Chimiro B chine mitsara 2 nemaceli 2, umo celi repamusoro kuruboshwe, repazasi kuruboshwe, nerepazasi kurudyi ari ■ uye celi repamusoro kurudyi i □ (chimiro che ㄴ). Kana chatendeudzwa kumusoro-pasi, repamusoro kuruboshwe, repamusoro kurudyi, nerepazasi kuruboshwe ari ■ uye repazasi kurudyi i □. Kana chatendeudzwa 180°, repamusoro kuruboshwe, repamusoro kurudyi, nerepazasi kurudyi ari ■ uye repazasi kuruboshwe i □.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.1.after: B i counterexample. 'Zvinogara zvakafanana' hazvirurami kana kunyange nyaya imwe yakasiyana. Asi hazvisi 'zvinogara zvakasiyana' futi (zvaiva zvakafanana kuna A).
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Zvakasiyana kuchimiro che ㄴ, saka chirevo che 'zvinogara zvakafanana' hachirurami
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakanzwisisa kuti counterexample imwe inoputsa 'nguva dzose'.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Iyo yakabuda yakasiyana yakadhirowa zvisiri izvo. Dzinofanira kugara dzakafanana
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kuongorora zvakare mhedzisiro yakadhirowa kwakanaka, asi kana ukafananidza nzvimbo dzemaceli zvakananga unogona kuona kuti dzakasiyana chaizvo.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Chimiro che ㄴ chete chakasiyana uye zvimwe zvimiro zvinogara zvakafanana
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kwabuda kusiyana kumwe, asi hapana hwaro hwekuti zvimwe zvimiro zvose zvakafanana.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Zvakasiyana kuchimiro che ㄴ, saka zvakasiyana kuzvimiro zvose
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Zvaiva zvakafanana kuna A. Haugoni kutaura kuti zvose zvakasiyana nokuti zvakasiyana kamwe.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Chimiro C chine mitsara 2 nemaceli 3, umo maceli ose 3 emutsara wepamusoro ari ■ uye mumutsara wepazasi celi repakati chete ri ■ (migumo ose maviri i □) (chimiro che T). Kana chatendeudzwa kumusoro-pasi, maceli ose 3 emutsara wepazasi ari ■ uye mumutsara wepamusoro repakati chete ri ■. Kana chatendeudzwa 180° chakafananawo. Zvakafanana. Chimiro D chimiro chine mitsara 2 nemaceli 2 umo celi repamusoro kuruboshwe chete ri ■.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zvaiva zvakafanana kuna A naC uye zvakasiyana kuna B. Fungidzira kana mhedzisiro mbiri dzaD dzichava dzakafanana kana dzakasiyana.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Musiyano pakati pekutendeuka kumusoro-pasi nekutendeuka 180° ndewekuti kuruboshwe nekurudyi zvinochinjana here. Kuzvimiro zvine kuruboshwe nekurudyi zvakafanana segirazi (A, C), zvakafanana kunyange zvichichinjana, uye kuzvimiro zvisina (B, D), zvakasiyana. Kune D, celi repamusoro kuruboshwe rinoenda pazasi kuruboshwe kana ratendeudzwa uye rinoenda pazasi kurudyi kana ratenderedzwa.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Zvakafanana. Kana pane celi rimwe chete, chimiro chakafanana kunyange chikafambiswa sei
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Nzvimbo yeceli inokosha. Funga kuti celi repamusoro kuruboshwe rinoenda kupi kana ratendeudzwa uye rinoenda kupi kana ratenderedzwa.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Zvakasiyana. Kuruboshwe nekurudyi kwayo hakuna kufanana segirazi, saka zvinoita sezvichasiyana seB
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakafungidzira uchishandisa musiyano wekuti A naC zvimiro zvine kuruboshwe nekurudyi zvakafanana, uye B hazvisi.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Zvakafanana. Zvakafanana kaviri uye zvakasiyana kamwe kusvika zvino, saka zvinogona kuva zvakafanana
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Panzvimbo pekuverenga huwandu hwenguva, unofanira kutsvaga zvinofanana zvimiro zvaiva zvakafanana.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Hazvigoni kufungidzirwa. Nokuti zvakasiyana kuchimiro chega chega
y-m-12-06.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Unogona kufungidzira kubva pazvinofanana A naC nekuti B inosiyana sei.
y-m-12-06.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga waiona sekuti unogona kutonga kubva pane chimwe chete, asi kana counterexample yabuda, 'nguva dzose' yakaputswa. Mushure meizvozvo, wakakwanisa kufungidzira chimiro chitsva nekutsvaga zvinofanana nyaya dzakafanana nedzakasiyana. Cherekedza kuti kunyange mushure mekuti 'zvinogara zvakafanana' zvaputswa, unogona kuwanabe 'apo zvakafanana'.
y-m-12-06.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira chimiro nekusarudza maceli e ■ mukati memitsara 2 nemaceli 3 (taura nzvimbo dzemaceli nemashoko). Fungidzira kana chimiro chakatendeudzwa kumusoro-pasi nechimiro chakatendeudzwa 180° zvichava zvakafanana kana zvakasiyana, uye unyorewo chikonzero.
y-m-12-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza celi rimwe re ■ uye utevere kuti rinoenda kupi kana rakatendeudzwa kumusoro-pasi uye rinoenda kupi kana rakatenderedzwa.
y-m-12-06.s.s2.hint.1: Usati wafungidzira, fananidza hafu yekuruboshwe nehafu yekurudyi yechimiro.
y-m-12-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Shamwari inogona kudhirowa chimiro chakafanana chaizvo nekuverenga nzvimbo dzemaceli echimiro chako here?
y-m-12-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Chikonzero chekufungidzira kwako chakabatana ne 'kuti kuruboshwe nekurudyi chimiro chakafanana here'?
y-m-12-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Mushure mekutendeudza nekutenderera chimiro chako zvechokwadi, kufungidzira kwako kwakarurama here?
y-m-12-06.s.s2.model.0: Ita celi rekuruboshwe repamutsara wepamusoro nerepakati repamutsara wepazasi chete ■. Kuruboshwe nekurudyi hakufanani segirazi, saka rakatendeudzwa kumusoro-pasi neratenderedzwa zvinoita sezvichasiyana.
y-m-12-06.s.s2.model.1: Kana maceli ari mamwe chete ari pamigumo yemutsara wepamusoro ari ■, kuruboshwe nekurudyi chimiro chakafanana segirazi. Saka chimiro chakatendeudzwa nechakatenderedzwa zvichafanana. Muzvose, maceli ari pamigumo yemutsara wepazasi anova ■.

y-m-12-07.title: Kufungidzira hurefu hwemubhinzi mavhiki anotevera
y-m-12-07.topic: Kufungidzira kukosha kusati kwayerwa kubva pagirafu yemutsetse
y-m-12-07.goal: Fungidzira kukosha kunotevera kubva pachimiro cheshanduko mugirafu yemutsetse, asi gadzirisa kufungidzira kwako nehuwandu hwaunovimbika kana data itsva yauya.
y-m-12-07.material: Sujin anoyera hurefu hwemubhinzi unomera kamwe pavhiki panguva imwe chete ndokuuratidza segirafu yemutsetse. Chikamu i cm, uye mumera unokurira muhari imwe chete pasi pemamiriro akafanana. Anoda kufungidzira hurefu muvhiki risati rayerwa nekutarisa girafu. Kufungidzira i 'zvinogona' chete, kwete chokwadi.
y-m-12-07.thinking.2: Kuongorora hwaro hwechirevo chinotaura chimwe chinhu nezveramangwana riri kure
y-m-12-07.s.s1.prompt: Data inoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kuti ungafungidzira sei hurefu hwevhiki rinotevera.
y-m-12-07.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wafananidza kana data itsva ichiwirirana nekufungidzira kusvika zvino.
y-m-12-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tsanangura nemashoko chimiro chemutsetse unobatanidza mapoinzi: unokwira, unononoka, kana unomira.

y-m-12-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wakawana mutemo weshanduko ukafungidzira, uye nekutaura 'inenge' hauna kuigadzika sechokwadi.
